stock.description: Tai Kam Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding firm, primarily focusing on construction and property enhancement projects across Hong Kong. Its core services involve comprehensive site preparation, which includes piling, as well as protective and restorative work to stabilize slopes and retaining walls. Additionally, the company undertakes fitting-out assignments for various premises. Founded in 2016, Tai Kam Holdings' main corporate office is situated in Central, Hong Kong.
